bioregion: Sonoran Desert • Yuma County, AZ & Imperial Valley, CA (KNYL / Lower Colorado River Basin)
model_architecture: BioCLIP TreeOfLife Taxonomic Vector Matcher + H3 Geo-Prior

taxa.safety_badge_en: SAFE NATIVE FLORA (DO NOT INGEST CONCENTRATED TEA — HEPATOTOXIC)
taxa.safety_badge_es: FLORA NATIVA SEGURA AL TACTO (NO INGERIR EN TÉ CONCENTRADO — HEPATOTÓXICO)
taxa.habitat_en: Lower Colorado River Valley bajadas, Yuma Mesa, Imperial Valley desert flats (0–1,200 m).
taxa.habitat_es: Bajadas del Valle del Bajo Río Colorado, Mesa de Yuma y planicies del Valle Imperial.
taxa.diagnostic_marks_en: Resinous dark-green-to-olive bifoliate leaves, yellow 5-petaled flowers, fuzzy white seed balls, unmistakable desert rain scent.
taxa.diagnostic_marks_es: Hojas dobles resinosas verde-olivo, flores amarillas de 5 pétalos, frutos blancos vellosos y el clásico olor a lluvia en el desierto.
taxa.clinical_rule_en: Safe on trails; however, clinical nutritionists caution against commercial 'chaparral tea' supplements due to nordihydroguaiaretic acid (NDGA) liver toxicity under DSHEA.
taxa.clinical_rule_es: Planta segura en senderos; sin embargo, evite cápsulas o tés concentrados de gobernadora por riesgo de toxicidad hepática.

taxa.safety_badge_es: ALIMENTO REAL DGA 2025-2030 (PRECAUCIÓN CON ESPINAS Y AHUATES)
taxa.habitat_en: Sonoran Desert washes, Telegraph Pass foothills, and regional home gardens.
taxa.habitat_es: Arroyos del Desierto de Sonora, laderas de Telegraph Pass y huertos familiares de la región.
taxa.diagnostic_marks_en: Flat green cladode pads (pencas) with clusters of spines and microscopic hair-like glochids; bright yellow flowers ripening into purple-red tunas.
taxa.diagnostic_marks_es: Pencas planas verdes con espinas y ahuates finos; flores amarillas que maduran en tunas rojas o púrpura.
taxa.clinical_rule_en: DGA 2025–2030 culturally familiar high-soluble-fiber vegetable (nopales) that slows postprandial glucose absorption for Type 2 diabetes and endurance fueling.
taxa.clinical_rule_es: Alimento real regional rico en fibra soluble (nopales) que estabiliza la glucosa en sangre y aporta electrolitos naturales.

taxa.safety_badge_es: ÁRBOL LEGUMINOSO DE ALIMENTO REAL (CUIDADO CON LAS ESPINAS)
taxa.habitat_en: Colorado River riparian corridor, Yuma West Wetlands, Imperial Valley canals.
taxa.habitat_es: Corredor ribereño del Río Colorado, Yuma West Wetlands y canales del Valle Imperial.
taxa.diagnostic_marks_en: Feathery bipinnate compound leaves, paired straight nodal thorns, yellow catkin flower spikes, and tan sweet legume pods (péchita).
taxa.diagnostic_marks_es: Hojas bipinnadas finas, espinas rectas en pares, flores en espiga amarilla y vainas dulces (péchita).
taxa.clinical_rule_en: Ground mesquite pod flour (péchita) provides low-glycemic complex carbohydrates, soluble fiber, calcium, and plant protein aligned with DGA 2025–2030.
taxa.clinical_rule_es: La harina de péchita aporta carbohidratos complejos de bajo índice glucémico, fibra, calcio y proteína vegetal.

taxa.safety_badge_en: PROTECTED SONORAN KEYSTONE SPECIES & TRADITIONAL FRUIT
taxa.safety_badge_es: ESPECIE PROTEGIDA DEL DESIERTO DE SONORA Y FRUTO TRADICIONAL
taxa.habitat_en: Kofa National Wildlife Refuge, Gila Mountains, and eastern Yuma County bajadas.
taxa.habitat_es: Refugio Nacional de Vida Silvestre Kofa, Montañas Gila y bajadas del este de Yuma.
taxa.diagnostic_marks_en: Tall pleated columnar trunk with upward-curving arms, nocturnal white waxy crown blossoms (May–June), and ruby-red split fruit.
taxa.diagnostic_marks_es: Cactus columnar gigante con brazos curvos hacia arriba, flores blancas en la corona y fruto rojo en verano.
taxa.clinical_rule_en: Protected Arizona native plant. Serves as a crucial visual landmark and shade/radiant-heat indicator during desert trail hikes.
taxa.clinical_rule_es: Especie protegida en Arizona y referente clave de orientación en rutas de senderismo en el desierto.

taxa.safety_badge_en: TRAIL MECHANICAL HAZARD — BARBED DETACHING STEMS
taxa.safety_badge_es: PELIGRO MECÁNICO EN SENDERO — SEGMENTOS CON ESPINAS BARBADAS
taxa.habitat_en: Rocky desert bajadas, Gila Mountains, Kofa foothills, and sandy desert washes.
taxa.habitat_es: Bajadas rocosas, Montañas Gila, laderas de Kofa y arroyos secos.
taxa.diagnostic_marks_en: Tree-like branching cylindrical stems covered in dense silvery-yellow barbed spines that detach at the slightest brush; hanging chains of green fruit.
taxa.diagnostic_marks_es: Tallos cilíndricos ramificados cubiertos de espinas plateadas/amarillas que se desprenden al menor roce.
taxa.clinical_rule_en: Maintain >= 1 meter trail clearance. Never remove cholla joints with bare fingers; use a comb or two stiff cards/sticks to flick the segment away parallel to the skin.
taxa.clinical_rule_es: Mantenga al menos 1 metro de distancia. Nunca retire segmentos con los dedos; use un peine o dos tarjetas rígidas para desprenderlo.

taxa.common_es: Víbora de Cascabel Diamante del Oeste
taxa.safety_badge_en: CRITICAL VENOMOUS TRAIL HAZARD — STOP & BACK AWAY (>= 2 METERS)
taxa.safety_badge_es: PELIGRO CRÍTICO VENENOSO — ALTO Y RETROCEDA (>= 2 METROS)
taxa.habitat_en: Yuma washes, agricultural canal banks, Telegraph Pass rocky ledges, and creosote flats.
taxa.habitat_es: Arroyos de Yuma, bordos de canales agrícolas, rocas de Telegraph Pass y matorrales.
taxa.diagnostic_marks_en: Heavy-bodied pit viper with dusty dorsal diamond blotches and bold black-and-white raccoon-like rings right before the keratin rattle.
taxa.diagnostic_marks_es: Cuerpo robusto con dibujos de diamantes en el dorso y anillos blancos y negros muy marcados antes del cascabel.
taxa.clinical_rule_en: RED-FLAG SAFETY GATE: Freeze, locate the snake, and back away slowly >= 6 feet. If bitten: call 911 immediately, keep limb at heart level, remove rings/watches, and NEVER apply tourniquets, ice, or suction.
taxa.clinical_rule_es: REGLA DE SEGURIDAD CRÍTICA: Deténgase y retroceda lentamente >= 2 metros. En caso de mordedura: llame al 911 de inmediato, retire anillos/relojes y NUNCA use torniquetes ni hielo.

taxa.safety_badge_en: CRITICAL VENOMOUS DUNE HAZARD — WATCH FOR HORNED SUPRAOCULAR SCALES
taxa.safety_badge_es: PELIGRO VENENOSO EN DUNAS — ESCAMAS SUPRAOCULARES EN FORMA DE CUERNO
taxa.habitat_en: Imperial Sand Dunes (Algodones Dunes), Barry M. Goldwater Range, and Yuma Mesa windblown sand.
taxa.habitat_es: Dunas de Algodones (Valle Imperial), Mesa de Yuma y suelos arenosos.
taxa.diagnostic_marks_en: Small pale sand-colored rattlesnake with raised horn-like scales over each eye that shade the eyes and keep sand out; leaves J-shaped tracks.
taxa.diagnostic_marks_es: Cascabel pequeña color arena con escamas levantadas como 'cuernitos' sobre los ojos; deja huellas en forma de J en la arena.
taxa.clinical_rule_en: Often buries flush in loose sand next to creosote shrubs at dusk/dawn. Wear closed-toe ankle-high footwear on sandy trails and carry a headlamp after sunset.
taxa.clinical_rule_es: Suele enterrarse al ras de la arena junto a arbustos al amanecer o anochecer. Use calzado cerrado que cubra el tobillo.

taxa.safety_badge_en: NEUROTOXIC ARACHNID HAZARD —FLUORESCES CYAN UNDER UV LIGHT
taxa.safety_badge_es: PELIGRO NEUROSIMPÁTICO — BRILLA AZUL-VERDE BAJO LUZ ULTRAVIOLETA
taxa.habitat_en: Under bark, palm fronds, block walls, and outdoor gym/patio equipment across Yuma & Imperial Valley.
taxa.habitat_es: Debajo de cortezas, palmas, bardas de bloque y equipo deportivo exterior en Yuma y Valle Imperial.
taxa.diagnostic_marks_en: Slender tan/yellowish scorpion (5–7 cm) with narrow pincers and a segmented tail held coiled to the side; glows bright neon cyan under 365–395 nm UV light.
taxa.diagnostic_marks_es: Alacrán delgado color miel pálido con pinzas finas; brilla intensamente bajo lámpara de luz negra (UV).
taxa.clinical_rule_en: Inspect shoes, gym bags, and outdoor yoga mats before use. Stings cause immediate burning/tingling; seek urgent medical care if cranial nerve symptoms (blurry vision, slurred speech) occur, especially in children or older adults.
taxa.clinical_rule_es: Revise calzado, mochilas y tapetes antes de entrenar al aire libre. Acuda a urgencias si hay entumecimiento severo o visión borrosa.

taxa.safety_badge_en: SAFE NATIVE SONORAN WILDLIFE — THERMOREGULATION MODEL
taxa.safety_badge_es: FAUNA NATIVA SEGURA — EJEMPLO DE TERMORREGULACIÓN EN EL DESIERTO
taxa.habitat_en: AWC Yuma Campus perimeter, East Wetlands, agricultural field edges, and desert scrub.
taxa.habitat_es: Alrededores del campus de AWC en Yuma, humedales y caminos rurales.
taxa.diagnostic_marks_en: Long-legged terrestrial cuckoo with shaggy crest, streaked brown-and-white plumage, long counterbalancing tail, and orange-blue postocular skin patch.
taxa.diagnostic_marks_es: Ave corredora de patas largas, cresta despeinada, cola larga de equilibrio y mancha azul-naranja detrás del ojo.
taxa.clinical_rule_en: Sprints up to 20 mph (32 km/h) and uses gular fluttering plus early-morning bimodal activity to avoid midday heat strain—just like our PAGA 2018 Yuma KNYL heat scheduling!
taxa.clinical_rule_es: Corre hasta 32 km/h y concentra su actividad temprano por la mañana y al atardecer para evitar el golpe de calor en Yuma.

taxa.safety_badge_en: SONORAN INDICATOR SHRUB — DROUGHT-DECIDUOUS SPINY CANES
taxa.safety_badge_es: ARBUSTO INDICADOR DEL DESIERTO — VARAS ESPINOSAS CON FLORES ROJAS
taxa.habitat_en: Well-drained rocky slopes around Telegraph Pass, Castle Dome, and Imperial County mountains.
taxa.habitat_es: Laderas rocosas de Telegraph Pass, Castle Dome y sierras del Valle Imperial.
taxa.diagnostic_marks_en: Cluster of 10–15 ft unbranched spiny canes radiating from a basal crown; leafs out rapidly after rain and bears fiery red-orange tubular flower clusters at cane tips in spring.
taxa.diagnostic_marks_es: Varas largas espinosas que nacen desde la base, reverdecen tras la lluvia y dan flores rojo encendido en las puntas en primavera.
taxa.clinical_rule_en: Important desert orientation plant; avoid brushing against dry cane spines on narrow singletrack trails.
taxa.clinical_rule_es: Planta clásica de referencia en senderos rocosos; precaución con las espinas largas en veredas estrechas.
